answer: Anchor each identity to a distinct residential electricity meter: the agent proves control of a smart meter whose consumption shows a living pulse of daily use, verified against the utility's signed readings. A falcon audit samples meters at random and revokes any whose load curve is cloned or flat. Standing grows only while the meter keeps consuming, and reaching the zenith of trust takes months of real usage. An attacker wanting a hundred identities must rent a hundred metered homes and pay a hundred real power bills, so the cost of a Sybil army equals the cost of a town's electricity.
